name: cloud-vault
description: Diego's Cloud Vault — standalone Vaultwarden client Android app. Hosts vault.diegonmarcos.com (self-hosted Vaultwarden) in a dedicated BrowserHostFragment APK with the constellation updater. Extracted from Cloud SuperApp's vault section (libs:vault was a KeePassDX stub) in favour of the full Vaultwarden web-app experience. Build via Nix devShell, one APK out.

vault._doc: Bitwarden-fork rebuild of this app — THE shipping Cloud-Vault.apk since 2026-08-18: CI's push-triggered job runs materialize-fork + build-fork and publishes the fork APK as Cloud-Vault.apk (GHCR :latest + GH release rolling tag). build.sh's default `build`/`release` still produce the legacy WebView wrapper, now a manual-only CI fallback. Uses the SAME fork machinery ea_cloud-mail's forks.mail entry uses (see cloud-mail-fork-engine.sh, ported verbatim into this app's build.sh).
vault.label: Cloud Vault (Bitwarden)

build._doc: Module `app` (applicationId com.x8bit.bitwarden upstream, com.diegonmarcos.cloudvault after patch 0001) is the password manager — NOT `authenticator`, a different product in the same repo. Flavor `fdroid` (dimension `mode`) is the Google-free flavor: Firebase/Crashlytics/ML-Kit/Play-Billing are standardImplementation-only and GoogleServices/Crashlytics tasks are disabled for fdroid in afterEvaluate. No release signingConfig is declared upstream (app/build.gradle.kts release buildType has none) so the APK comes out unsigned from gradle; build-fork's unconditional _enforce_signature re-signs it with the ONE shared constellation key regardless — no 'signing' key needed here.
build._build_blocker_doc: com.bitwarden:sdk-android is resolved from https://maven.pkg.github.com/bitwarden/sdk (settings.gradle.kts dependencyResolutionManagement), which 401s without an authenticated GitHub account/token even for public artifacts — verified un-buildable anonymously (local sandbox). settings.gradle.kts reads the credential as: password = userProperties["gitHubToken"] (rootDir/user.properties, gitignored, local-dev only) ?: System.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN") ; username is hardcoded to "" (empty). RESOLVED in CI (run 31602029574, 2026-08-12): the auto-minted per-run GITHUB_TOKEN reads bitwarden/sdk packages fine — no BITWARDEN_PACKAGES_TOKEN PAT needed (the workflow still prefers that secret if ever set). Locally, put a token in user.properties. Not a gradle_props entry — it's a plain env var upstream settings.gradle.kts reads.

vault.comment: Bitwarden Android (password manager). Rebrand + self-hosted-server-default + NOTICE patches in ea_cloud-vault/patches/. materialize-fork is pure git clone+patch (no network auth); build-fork VERIFIED green in CI 2026-08-12 (run 31602029574, signed 36 MB fdroid/release APK) and promoted 2026-08-18 to the push-triggered publisher of Cloud-Vault.apk.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps (Cloud-Comms hub+forks, Cloud-Nav, Cloud-Wallet, Cloud-Browser, Cloud-Vault, Cloud-IDE, Cloud-SuperApp). The SAME key signs every app so cross-app signature-IPC + the in-app fleet updater never hit a signature mismatch. KEY LOCATION (raw credential + sops passwords live ONLY in the vault repo): A0_keys/providers/android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A0_keys/providers/android/signing.secrets.yaml. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR (default ~/git/cloud-vault) + sops-decrypts the passwords, exporting ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE/ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD which the gradle signingConfig reads. CI does the same via a vault checkout + the SOPS_AGE_KEY secret. THERE IS NO FALLBACK: if the key is unavailable the build FAILS LOUD.

diagnostics._doc: On-device DevControlServer diagnostics → cloud sink. Baked into BuildConfig.LOG_SINK_URL / LOG_SINK_STREAM by app/build.gradle. Empty url = cloud push disabled.

toolchain._doc: Pinned for reproducibility — all derived in flake.nix. Bump here, rebuild devShell.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph. settings.gradle iterates this list.

libs:core._doc_dir: Shared BY REFERENCE from ea_cloud-superapp/libs/ — settings.gradle points projectDir here instead of at a local copy. Every app used to carry its own copy-pasted tree and they drifted: 6 apps sat 228 source lines behind superapp's updater. One directory, no sync step, no drift.

libs:devtools._doc_dir: Shared BY REFERENCE from ea_cloud-superapp/libs/, same as libs:core. Not listed in app.depends_on and not linked in app/build.gradle: libs:core pulls it in with an `api` dependency, which is what gives every app the constellation-wide debug API (127.0.0.1:38090+, own-process logcat) without per-app wiring that would drift.

libs:browser._doc_dir: Shared BY REFERENCE from ea_cloud-superapp/libs/ - settings.gradle points projectDir here instead of at a local copy. browser was three byte-identical trees (superapp, browser, vault); nothing kept them in step, so a WebView fix had to be pasted three times or it silently reached one app.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
